mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS id, r.room_number AS roomNo, r.building_id AS buildingId, b.campus_id AS campusId FROM dorm_room r LEFT JOIN dorm_building b ON r.building_id = b.id WHERE r.id = #{id}

SELECT r.id AS roomId, r.room_number AS roomNumber, b.id AS buildingId, b.building_name AS buildingName, b.campus_id AS campusId, c.campus_name AS campusName FROM dorm_room r LEFT JOIN dorm_building b ON r.building_id = b.id LEFT JOIN sys_campus c ON b.campus_id = c.id WHERE r.id = #{id}
